items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I saw him do as a kid... he used to bet on it, and he used to win, you know? The guy was fantastic.

ctx.x: Do you remember where it was? The medicine show?

No ... it was in the south someplace, though. Someplace in the south, because -- here's another thing that Bill Robinson did, and I'm sure that people that is in to him will know this. He used to do something which I saw him do as a kid, he would run backwards faster than most people could run forward. And he used to bet on it, and he used to win, you know? The guy was fantastic. You look that up sometimes, and see how Bill Robinson could run backwards faster than most people could run forward, and he won a lot…
You danced before you played drums, right?

items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I remember, I saw Bill Bojangles Robinson with a Medicine Show.

ctx.x: About ... well I was. Let's go back to the beginning. The first thing I can remember, almost from all of my life I can remember that I was in show business. Okay?

I remember very little about New Orleans; very, very little -- nothing. All I remember is playing under the house and that type of thing, but I was like 5 years old when I left New Orleans, so my dad took the three of us -- it was a separation -- and he took the 3 of us and we went on the road.
